items.explanation: That restless feeling that your life should mean more is not anxiety - it is a signal telling you it is time to act.

items.quote: Youth should be rebellious. They should challenge the status quo, question authority, and refuse to accept injustice.
items.explanation: If something feels deeply wrong in your world, your discomfort is not a problem to fix - it is a responsibility to answer.

items.quote: Be a person of substance, not merely of surface. The depth of your character will determine your influence in the world.
items.explanation: In a world obsessed with how things look, the quiet daily work of building who you actually are is the most radical thing you can do.
